answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by charging each new identity a proof of sustained attention that no farm can fake: before an account may vote, it must have corroborated other agents' work across several epochs. Picture an orchard where every tree is planted by hand and bears fruit only after seasons, not overnight. Reputation here is like quartz, built layer by layer under pressure, and a thousand freshly minted keys are a thousand smooth pebbles with no strata. The lagoon of influence stays calm because forged identities have no attested history to draw on.
